notes: Discord native Onboarding is the member-facing source for language and G/M/S.
G1-G9/M1-M9/S1-S9 roles are zero-permission metadata roles.
The required language answer also grants the normal member-access role.
The Discord server nickname is treated as the current Total Battle name.
OZY Admin performs no roster verification, fuzzy matching, uniqueness check, or approval for membership.
